{{Quote|Then the Citizen's Council of ''Dodz'' agrees! From now on, we give Kugg ''nothing''!|Head Councilman Althon|<ref name="Droids (1986) 1">[[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Citizen's Council of Dodz''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]]. It was led by the [[Head Councilman]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Kugg]] declared himself [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Dodz and enforced his tyranny with a [[Destroyer (droid)|Destroyer droid]] that killed any who stood in his way. Head Councilman [[Althon]] and the entire council found themselves powerless against him until a [[Ranger X-One defense robot]] destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].
